method: Three subagents partitioned 87 failed responses, one independent review per response, not three-reviewer consensus. Distinct assessments retained; no cross-run deduplication. Strict automatic candidates are named reference additions to existing items, pending target/hash and coverage verification. No source-level validation or patch trial was performed. Tests, behavior changes, specification decisions and disputed interpretation are excluded. Finding granularity is reviewer judgment; response-level figures are primary. Passing rationales are unavailable and not classified.
